title: CompactProductRealizationLaws
statement: Fix the finite datum $P$, ring $A$ and field $k$ of [def-pur-conventions], finite-Tor constructible inputs [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and retained bounded-below etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Use the canonical realization maps [def-pur-compact-product-realization-arrows], actual pro-etale proper-support, class-image and excision arrows [def-pur-proper-support-compact-maps], and the four core propositions [def-pur-compact-product-realization-core-laws]. Define five further universally quantified propositions for separated finite-type $k$-schemes and all indicated proper compactifications and proper closed supports: the actual pro-etale supported exterior map and three transported $u_Z$ maps satisfy the compact-product square using the specified output comparison; every transported $u_Z$ is the actual pro-etale constant-section-unit/counit composite; for every integer $a$ and every supported class morphism its adjunction transpose followed by that actual $u_Z$ equals its constant-section-unit class image; for every bounded-below pro-etale extension with specified restriction isomorphism, excision is invertible and the composite through compact support equals inverse excision followed by forgetting support; two arbitrary retained witnesses give the same transported $u_Z$. Define CompactProductRealizationLaws as the conjunction of the four core and these five further propositions. No etale-origin hypothesis is imposed on an extension. The ordinary-site input predicate and supported coefficient unit use [def-pur-supported-class-geometry].
